## 🎮 Gamearn v2.0.6.2 — Lúdò Build Fix

### What's Fixed
- ✅ **Fixed tokenCount parameter error** in LudoGameScreen initialization
- ✅ APK build now completes successfully

### What's Included (from v2.0.6.1)
- ✅ **Lúdò (Ludo) game** with full 2-player + AI bot support
- ✅ Token count selector in game lobby (2 or 4 pieces)
- ✅ Ludo AI heuristic bot (instant, Render-safe)
- ✅ Dice rolls, piece movement, capture mechanics, home stretch
- ✅ Bonus roll on 6, consecutive six cancellation
- ✅ Win detection and game over dialog

### Features
- 2-player mode: Human controls Red + Yellow; Bot controls Green + Blue
- Configurable token count (2 or 4 pieces per player)
- OpenSpiel Ludo engine with AI decision-making
- Real-time piece animation and board state tracking
- Full game flow: lobby → token selection → game play → win screen
- Full auth flow + home dashboard
- Whot game with AI opponent
- Wallet, tournaments, leaderboard
- Profile, settings, streaks

### Bot API Requirements
- Bot API: `https://gamearn-ai.onrender.com` (configurable)
- Ludo heuristic dispatcher in `ai_service.py`
- Instant move selection (no MCTS timeout risk)
